asked: A full --fidelity preset search was run at 60 s and diffed but never adopted (C:/t/hr1_candidate.json). asked: Powerplay refuses --regrid on a 2.88pp melody drop that is 94% a naming artefact. The analogous case (One_on_One) was refused on the same evidence shape and REVERSED when the window moved 60 -> 180 s. Adopt now, re-measure at 180 s first, or keep the refusal?
head: c490b72
notes: The answer carries its own decision rule, so the runner does not re-derive it: if the 2.88pp survives at 180 s keep the refusal, if it collapses or reverses as One_on_One's did, adopt. One file, one A/B -- cheap next to the corpus refresh.
